description:
HandyDadTV is a resource to inspire hands-on homeowners around the world in the areas of lawn care, smart home technology, DIY projects and more. Chris Heider, aka "your virtual dad in the cloud", shares over 30 years of homeowner experience from his home in New Jersey.

We love to partner with product brands that match our mission and benefit our audience. Please email chris@handydad.tv for sponsorship opportunities.
